panels.name: Troll terraces: Vosh'gajin, Bijou and Voone

markers.to: 01:I <-> 02:I; lower-city fork to the troll area
02:I -> 02:II; one-way ledge drop from the troll-area entrance to Orc Alley; return from Voone to the marked ledge first
02:II <-> 03:I; spider ramps ascend to the Urok platform

uncertain: Terrace elevations and ramp bends are compressed; the source describes the area sequence, not measured landings.
C is a documented one-way drop, but its exact safe take-off and landing coordinates are unverified. Dashed endpoints are not navigation coordinates.
The exact paths of Bannok Grimaxe and Crystal Fang, egg locations, Bijou and tablet positions remain approximate.
Bijou's Belongings and Blackrock Documents have variable locations; Human Remains and Unfired Plate Gauntlets are omitted pending positional evidence.
notes: Original schematic for Vanilla/Classic 1.12; not to scale. Dashed outlines indicate unverified local geometry or approximate marker positions.
Panel positions are for page layout, not a common compass or measured elevation. Paired letters connect fields; arrows identify local vertical movement.
Boss numbering suggests a full-clear route including optional encounters; it is not a mandatory kill order. Return along the same path from dead ends unless a one-way transition is stated.
Return from Voone to the troll-area entrance before using C. No direct tunnel from Voone to the spiders is asserted.
Mor Grayhoof is summoned in Voone's room for the Tier 0.5 chain; marker 7 is optional.
